Meeting Date:                  3/15/2023
Sponsor(s):                    Scott (24)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 2-J at 3431 and 3433 W
                              Flournoy St
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                         ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby

amended by changing all of the RT4 Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District symbols and

indications as shown on Map No. 2J in the area bounded by:

       West Floumoy Street; a line 285.81 feet east of the east line of South St. Louis
       Avenue; the public alley next south of and parallel to West Floumoy Street; a line
       223.31 feet east of the east line of South St. Louis Avenue,

to those of an RS3 Single-Unit Detached House District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance takes effect after its^a^sage and due publication.



                                            Mohique L. Scl^tt
                                            Alderman, 24"^ Ward
